summary: Penske Automotive Group filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, reporting that its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.46 per share, payable December 1, 2026, to holders of record November 13, 2026. The $0.02 (1.4%) increase annualizes to $5.84 per share. No advisor, premium, or transaction terms apply; this is a routine capital-return declaration rather than a special situation, with no structural, regulatory, or risk-arbitrage angle to monitor.
